scope: Refresh-after-payment UX fix in order-flow.js: persistent sd_last_delivered breadcrumb so a paid customer who refreshes the STATIC Grow thank-you redirect (?paid=1, pending already cleared) sees the success state instead of the alarming 'order lost / email us' fallback. No change to the payment-critical send/clear/pixel-guard logic beyond adding the breadcrumb write.
automated_coverage_details: order-flow.js logic re-verified via agent-browser eval harness on a local http server, with Formspree POSTs intercepted by an --init-script fetch override (window.fetch wraps real fetch, short-circuits any formspree.io URL to a fake 200 and records it on window.__formspreeHits). Zero real Formspree submissions. Verified: successful delivery now also writes sd_last_delivered {id,pkg,price,at}; breadcrumb survives the sd_pending_order clear; breadcrumb success path is gated on 24h recency AND (no ?order OR ?order===breadcrumb.id); stale (>24h) breadcrumb does NOT trigger success; breadcrumb branch never calls postToFormspree and never calls trackPixelEvent.
browser_test_details: Headless Chromium via agent-browser on http://localhost:8899 serving deploy/, Formspree mocked (0 real hits). Case a (normal success, matching sd_pending_order, ?paid=1&pkg=vip): 1 intercepted Formspree POST, title 'הרכישה הושלמה!', order number SD-20260719-QAAB shown, sendOk visible, sendLost hidden, pending cleared, sd_last_delivered written (id/pkg vip/price 870/at). Case b (reload same URL after success, pending gone + breadcrumb present): __formspreeHits=0 on the reload load (NO resend, key evidence), success UI 'הרכישה הושלמה!' + order number from breadcrumb, sendOk visible, sendLost hidden, no pixel re-fire (breadcrumb branch calls neither postToFormspree nor trackPixelEvent; top-level pixel block skipped because resolved orderId is empty). Case c (empty localStorage, no pending + no breadcrumb): sendLost fallback visible, sendOk hidden, mailto fallback intact, 0 Formspree hits. Case d (only a 48h-old stale breadcrumb, no pending): sendLost visible, sendOk + orderChip hidden, 0 Formspree hits, NO false success. Screenshots in ../temp/refresh-ux-qa/.
known_flags: Real Grow payment cannot be completed in automated QA (needs a live transaction). Grow's success redirect is STATIC and does not carry the order id; localStorage remains the source of truth. The refresh-after-success 'order lost' regression noted in the prior report is now FIXED via the sd_last_delivered breadcrumb (24h recency guard). Note: on any ?paid=1 load the top-level applyPaidUI still sets the 'הרכישה הושלמה' title even in the genuinely-lost / stale-breadcrumb cases; this is pre-existing behavior and the email fallback (sendLost) is shown beneath it, sendOk/orderChip stay hidden. Still pending real-transaction verification: that Grow preserves our ?paid=1&pkg=... query string on redirect.
